_comment: Simulates the other client shape: raw rendered DOM handed over by a webview. The extractor parses OpenGraph/JSON-LD out of it server-side, so the client does not need to know our field names at all.
html:
The query planner was doing a sequential scan across eleven million rows because the boolean column had terrible selectivity in the statistics.

A partial index covering only the rows where the flag is true brought the index down to a few thousand entries, small enough to stay resident in cache.

The rewrite took four lines. The measured improvement was from just under forty seconds to twelve milliseconds on the same hardware.
